# Document Preamble 
```{r preamble, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load libraries
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(data.table)
library(here)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)

# call environmental data
library(terra)

# analysis
library(momentuHMM)
library(adehabitatLT)
library(mitools)

# visualization 
library(ggplot2)

options(width = 150)
```

## 1.1. Format of tracking data

Read in the prep data
```{r read in prep data}
# Location data of the oryx 
oryx.2018 <- readRDS(here::here("data", "04.04.2025_hourly_final_preHMM_dataset.Rdata"))
# remove everything before the dash in ID columns
oryx.2018$ID <- sub("-.*", "", oryx.2018$ID)

# ensure it is arrange with time per ID
oryx.2018 <- oryx.2018 %>% group_by(ID) %>% arrange(ID, time) %>% ungroup() %>% as.data.frame()
```

prepare data for HMM format
```{r HMM formats}
# prepare data for HMM (compute step lengths and turning angles)
data_hmm <- momentuHMM::prepData(oryx.2018, type = "UTM", covNames = c("shrub", "time_since_release"))

# check the hmm dataset
head(data_hmm, 10)
```

# Non-constrained 4-state HMM

null model without any restriction
```{r 4 state hmm covariates}
# number of states 
nbStates <- 4

# label states
stateNames <- c("1" = "S","2" = "I","3" = "R", "4" = "D")

# Observation distributions (step lengths, turning angles)
dist <- list(step = "gamma", 
             angle = "vm")

# Initial parameters
# (step mean for state 1, step mean for state 2, step mean for state N so on... same for step SD s1, step SD s2) and (angle concentration s1, angle concentration s2)
Par0_4s <- list(step = c(761, 300, 750, 4,   # step means
                         1103, 442, 1000, 4),  # step sds
                angle = c(-0.02, 0.24, -0.01, -3,  # angle means
                          0.4, 0.015, 0.3, 0.57) # angle concentrations
               )

# Specify whether to estimate angle means
estAngleMean <- list(angle = TRUE)

# make sure the transition between resting to death for shrub cover effects also 0 -- independent. 
fixbeta <-  matrix(c( # S: 1->2          1->3                1->4                
                            NA, NA, NA,   -1e6, -1e6, -1e6,   -1e6, -1e6, -1e6,   
                      # I: 2->1                2->3           2->4              
                            -1e6, -1e6, -1e6,  NA, NA, NA,    NA, 0, 0,
                      # R: 3->1                 3->2                3->4            
                            -1e6, -1e6, -1e6,   -1e6, -1e6, -1e6,   -1e6, -1e6, -1e6,
                      # D: 4->1               4->2                 4->3          
                            -1e6, -1e6, -1e6,  -1e6, -1e6,  -1e6,  -1e6, -1e6, -1e6), 
                   nrow = 1, 
                   byrow = TRUE)

# fix initial values 
fixPar0 <- list(beta = fixbeta)

# Fit an unconstrained model
hmm <- momentuHMM::fitHMM(data_hmm, 
                          nbStates = nbStates, 
                          dist = dist, 
                          Par0 = Par0_4s,
                          fixPar = fixPar0,
                          formula = ~shrub + time_since_release,
                          estAngleMean = estAngleMean,
                          #knownStates=data_hmm$death,
                          stateNames = stateNames)

hmm

# save the hmm output 
readr::write_rds(hmm, path = here("data", "09.02.2025.4s_SIR_remain_v2.Rdata"))
```

save the viberti
```{r state spatial visualization}
states <- momentuHMM::viterbi(hmm)
data_hmm1 <- data.frame(data_hmm)
data_hmm1$states <- states
data_hmm1$states <- factor(states, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))

# save the rds file for the state sequences 
readr::write_rds(data_hmm1, path = here("data", "09.02.2025.4s_SIR_remain_v2_viberti.Rdata"))
```

save the plots as a pdf
```{r example, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
pdf("SIR_remained_v2_HMM.pdf")
plot(hmm, breaks = 20, ask=FALSE)
dev.off()
```

```{r time series plot}
sir_vib <- data_hmm1 %>% dplyr::select(ID, step, states)
sir_vib$ID <- sub("-.*", "", sir_vib$ID)
sir_vib1 <- sir_vib %>% na.omit()

ggplot(sir_vib1, aes(1:nrow(sir_vib1), step, col = states, group = NA)) + 
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 0.5)  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#E69F00", "#0072B2", "black"), 
                     labels = c("1; S(Susceptible)", 
                                "2; I (Infected)", 
                               "4; D (Dead)"),
                     name = "State") +
    facet_wrap("ID", scales = "free_x") +
    labs(x = "Time", y = "Step length", col = "State") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(strip.text = element_blank(), 
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          axis.text = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks = element_blank())+
  ylim(0, 3000)
```
